privacy_s1_p1: This Privacy Policy explains how Transcendence collects, uses and protects information when you use our application. Transcendence is a social web application developed as part of an educational project.
privacy_s2_p1: Depending on how you use the application, we may store the following information:
privacy_s2_item3: Password information in securely hashed form.
privacy_s2_item6: Posts and content submitted by you.
privacy_s2_item7: Messages and friend relationships within the application.
privacy_s3_p1: Transcendence may allow you to authenticate using your 42 account. When using this option, the application receives information provided by the 42 authentication service, such as your 42 identifier, username, email address and profile information.
privacy_s3_p2: This information is used only to create and maintain your Transcendence account and provide the application's functionality.
privacy_s4_p1: The information stored by Transcendence is used to:
privacy_s4_item2: Authenticate you and maintain your session.
privacy_s4_item4: Allow you to interact with other users.
privacy_s4_item5: Display posts and other content you publish.
privacy_s4_item6: Provide the application's social and communication features.
privacy_s4_item7: Maintain the security and proper operation of the application.
privacy_s5_p1: Content that you voluntarily publish through Transcendence, including posts, profile information and messages, may be stored by the application in order to provide its features.
privacy_s5_p2: You are responsible for the content you submit and should avoid publishing information that you do not want to share with other users.
privacy_s6_p1: Account and application data is stored in the application's database. Passwords for accounts created with username and password authentication are stored using password hashing rather than as plain text.
privacy_s6_p2: We take reasonable technical measures to protect stored information. However, no online service can guarantee absolute security.
privacy_s7_p1: Transcendence uses session information to keep users authenticated while they use the application. These sessions are necessary for features such as login, profile management, friends and messaging.
privacy_s8_p1: We do not sell your personal information. Information may be processed by external authentication services when you explicitly choose to use them, such as the 42 authentication service.
privacy_s9_p1: Account and user-generated information may remain stored while your account is active and for as long as necessary to provide the application's functionality.
privacy_s10_p1: Depending on applicable data protection law, you may have rights concerning your personal information, including the right to access, correct or request deletion of your data.
privacy_s11_p1: This Privacy Policy may be updated when the application's functionality or data practices change. The latest version will always be available through the application's Privacy Policy link.
privacy_s12_p1: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or the handling of information within Transcendence, please contact the project administrators through the available project channels.
terms_s1_p1: By accessing or using Transcendence, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, you should not use the application.
terms_s2_p1: Transcendence is a social web application developed as part of an educational project. It provides features including user accounts, profiles, posts, friendships and private messaging.
terms_s3_p1: You are responsible for the information associated with your account and for keeping your authentication credentials secure.
terms_s3_p2: You must not impersonate another person or create an account using information intended to deceive other users.
terms_s4_p1: You agree to use Transcendence responsibly and not to use the application to:
terms_s4_item1: Harass, threaten or abuse other users.
terms_s4_item4: Distribute malicious software or attempt to compromise the application.
terms_s4_item5: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to another user's account.
terms_s4_item6: Abuse, overload or intentionally disrupt the service.
terms_s4_item7: Use the application for fraudulent or deceptive purposes.
terms_s5_p1: You retain responsibility for the content you submit, including posts, profile information and messages.
terms_s5_p2: By submitting content to Transcendence, you grant the application the limited permission necessary to store, process and display that content as part of the application's features.
terms_s6_p1: Content that is illegal, threatening, abusive, fraudulent, excessively offensive or intended to harm other users is not permitted.
terms_s6_p2: The application may restrict or remove content that violates these terms or interferes with the safe operation of the service.
terms_s7_p1: If you choose to authenticate using 42, your use of that authentication method is also subject to the applicable terms and policies of the 42 platform.
terms_s8_p1: Access to an account may be restricted or suspended when necessary to protect the application, its users or its infrastructure, particularly in cases involving abuse, unauthorized access or violations of these Terms of Service.
terms_s9_p1: Transcendence is an educational project and is provided on an as-is basis. Availability, functionality and features may change during development, and continuous availability cannot be guaranteed.
terms_s10_p1: You must not attempt to bypass security mechanisms, access restricted resources or interfere with the operation of the application.
terms_s11_p1: These Terms of Service may be updated when the application or its functionality changes. The latest version will be available through the Terms of Service link in the application.
terms_s12_p1: Questions regarding these Terms of Service can be directed to the project administrators through the available project channels.
